Afghanistan
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Islamabad, Pakistan.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Vienna
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
